title: ID0413139-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / SD 170004241] Unable to charge on DC1 & DC2
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
On DC1 it never get past cable check and on DC2 it gets alarms on cable temp sensors etc.
Root cause: XD11 loose
Solution: Reinsert XD11
